snippet.title: NERF 2: "N-Strike" Elite trailer (Wii Video)
snippet.description: Here is the new trailer for the upcoming Hasbro and EA title, NERF 2: "N-Strike" Elite, exclusively for the Nintendo Wii. The game hits U.S. store shelves October 27th, 2009.
